categories.label: Unclassified
categories.description: Motions that have not yet been processed by the classification workflow.

categories.label: Housing & development
categories.description: Housing supply, affordability, zoning, rezonings, tenant policy, development approvals, and land use.

categories.label: Transportation & streets
categories.description: Walking, cycling, transit, roads, parking, traffic safety, freight, and street allocation.

categories.label: Climate & environment
categories.description: Emissions, climate adaptation, waste, water, biodiversity, energy, and environmental protection.

categories.label: Public safety
categories.description: Police, fire and rescue, emergency planning, street safety, and community safety programs.

categories.label: Homelessness & social services
categories.description: Homelessness, poverty reduction, public health, social services, shelters, and community supports.

categories.label: City finance & taxes
categories.description: Budgets, property tax, fees, borrowing, grants, procurement, and financial management.

categories.label: Governance & accountability
categories.description: Elections, transparency, ethics, oversight, intergovernmental relations, and Council governance.

categories.label: Economic development
categories.description: Jobs, tourism, business support, major events, commercial activity, and local economic strategy.

categories.label: Parks, culture & public space
categories.description: Parks, recreation, libraries, arts, heritage, public art, plazas, and civic events.

categories.label: Infrastructure & core services
categories.description: Utilities, sewers, sanitation, civic facilities, asset management, and operational services.

categories.label: Equity & reconciliation
categories.description: Indigenous relations, accessibility, human rights, anti-racism, gender equity, and inclusion.

categories.label: Licensing & regulation
categories.description: Business licensing, short-term rentals, alcohol, animals, noise, and other regulatory bylaws.

categories.label: Procedural & administrative
categories.description: Appointments, meeting procedure, administrative authorizations, scheduling, and non-policy formalities.

categories.label: Other
categories.description: Substantive motions that do not fit another category.
